## Decisions
- [NB-20261002-01](2026-10-02.md) X6 discriminator_r1: one-vs-rest R1 penalty (gamma/2) mean_i ||grad_z D_{b_i}(z_i)||^2 with D_k = l_k - log sum_{j!=k} exp(l_j), at every minibatch cell, gamma = 10, in the discriminator step only, 1 discriminator step per generator step (by user) — corrected by NB-20261002-15
- [NB-20261002-02](2026-10-02.md) X7 discriminator_ref (reference JS): per-batch binary heads 'batch k vs reference', class-balanced cross-entropy, non-saturating generator loss with labels flipped on both sides, reference cells not detached, 1 discriminator step per generator step (by user) — corrected by NB-20261002-16
- [NB-20261002-03](2026-10-02.md) X8 stratified sampler for the critic arms only (reference, pooled): 128/V cells per batch per minibatch, without replacement per batch, epoch = ceil(n_train/128) steps, fit fails when a batch has fewer training cells than its quota (by user) — corrected by NB-20261002-17
- [NB-20261002-04](2026-10-02.md) X3 oracle importance weights undo the induced depletion: target = each batch's pre-depletion composition, w = 1/keep-fraction for depleted-type cells of the depleted batch and 1 otherwise, same weights in discriminator, reference, pooled and MMD, self-normalised in adversary and generator steps, doses 50/80/95 only (by user) — corrected by NB-20261002-18
- [NB-20261002-21](2026-10-02.md) Fresh seeds for all lambda-matched follow-ups: X3, X6, X7, X8 and X12 use seeds 10-12, disjoint from X1 (0-4) and A1/A2/A3 (100-102), so no follow-up cell reuses an X1 fit that chose its matched lambda; X13 is not lambda-matched and keeps seeds 0-4 (by user)
- [NB-20261002-22](2026-10-02.md) A2/A3 also run with the unconditioned decoder, one pooled decision: the same R2/R3 rule over task x arm x decoder cells (A2 12, A3 20; at least 8 and 14 evaluable), the sign criterion checked per task x decoder; the unconditioned default halves are A1 unconditioned fits (by user)
- [NB-20261002-23](2026-10-02.md) Include trajectory conservation in the bio score (score_scib_native.BIO_METRICS), as scIB does: computed where the prepped file has obs dpt_pseudotime (immune, immune_hum_mou), NaN and skipped elsewhere (by user)
- [NB-20261002-24](2026-10-02.md) Every cluster job submission (JHPCE: setup, tests, benchmarks, experiments) needs the user's explicit go; show what will run, where and for how long first. Local runs do not need a go but are reported. (by user)
- [NB-20261002-25](2026-10-02.md) score_scib_native.py sets R's RNG with set.seed(KBET_SEED) immediately before every R kBET call and writes kbet_seed and kbet_r_calls per row; the PAPER_PLAN sec 5 measurement-SD step varies KBET_SEED; prereg rule scripts reject unseeded score files and mixed seeds (by lead agent instruction (2026-10-03), answering the kBET question of NB-20261002-10; the Harmony question there stays open)
- [NB-20261002-28](2026-10-02.md) GO: BIO_METRICS += trajectory and seeded kBET in score_scib_native.py; experiment-preflight 46 items, 13 pass, 33 n/a, 0 blocking, 0 major fails (by agent, by the preflight verdict; metric choice by the user (SI-28))
- [NB-20261003-01](2026-10-03.md) every X3 row carries an explicit reference = select_reference_batch on the dose-0 subsample, at every dose; the depleted batch is always a non-reference batch (only atac_small changes target) (by user via lead (ask_user 2026-10-03): "Fix reference; deplete a non-reference batch (Recommended)")
- [NB-20261003-02](2026-10-03.md) sim2 X3 depletes only Group1 in Batch3Sub1 (Group1 1,446 and Group2 484 cells), so the batch stays at every dose (by user via lead (ask_user 2026-10-03): "Deplete only Group1 (Recommended)")
- [NB-20261003-03](2026-10-03.md) atac_small depletes Excitatory Neurons and Inhibitory Neurons in 'Fang et al. - CEMBA180305_2B' (largest non-reference batch, 3,750 cells; 2,868 depletable) (by user (ask_user 2026-10-03): "Fang: Excitatory + Inhibitory (Recommended)")
- [NB-20261003-04](2026-10-03.md) Harmony strength knob theta in {0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8} at 10 PCs, each once (harmonize random_state 0, fresh process, pinned threads); 50 PCs at theta 2 as sensitivity (by user (ask_user 2026-10-03): "theta {0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8} (Recommended)")
- [NB-20261003-05](2026-10-03.md) Scanorama strength knob knn in {5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 160} at dimred 10, each once (seed 0); dimred 100 at knn 20 as sensitivity (by user (ask_user 2026-10-03): "knn {5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 160} (Recommended)")
- [NB-20261003-06](2026-10-03.md) PCA runs once at 10 PCs (plus the 50-PC tool default as sensitivity) and is shown as the uncorrected anchor, not as a best-of-k budget curve (by user (ask_user 2026-10-03): "Once, as uncorrected anchor (Recommended)")
- [NB-20261003-10](2026-10-03.md) the 8 new-arm rows of docs/throughput_rtx3080_stock_backbone.csv are replaced by the run2 medians; mmd_iw (spread 0.304 > 0.25) stays marked provisional in scripts/wall_time_report.py; the gated run4 was cancelled before any fit (by lead (a0b87862), message of 2026-10-03 ~16:18 UTC; departs from the pre-declared rule in the preflight plan)
- [NB-20261003-11](2026-10-03.md) NonFiniteLossError (status diverged, PREREG sec. 1) when (a) any loss term a training step computes or back-propagates is non-finite (scVI loss; adv_term, gen_loss, adversary loss and GP; scvi_adv classifier and fool losses), (b) the training forward pass fails torch.distributions argument validation ('Expected parameter ...', e.g. NaN q_m), or (c) a parameter is non-finite after the last optimizer step. The posterior mean is computed with distribution validation off, so a NaN latent is saved and recorded as nonfinite_latent instead of crashing. (by agent (implementation of PREREG sec. 1); flagged to the lead for confirmation)
- [NB-20261003-12](2026-10-03.md) Infrastructure errors: at most --max-attempts 2 per tag and kind in a run, then no new work is started, running work finishes, exit 5 with the log path. Claims: owner identified by host, /etc/machine-id, boot time, pid namespace, pid and process start; an owner whose liveness cannot be checked (other host, container, sandbox, no machine-id) is 'foreign' and needs --clear-foreign-claims; only verifiably dead owners are 'stale' (--clear-stale-claims). Outputs that break the fitter/scorer contract are moved to OUT/quarantine/, never deleted. Fits read a snapshot of the manifest (OUT/manifests/<sha>.tsv). A scoring-only run skips the fit-device probe. (by agent (implementation))
- [NB-20261003-20](2026-10-03.md) Launch A1 (1,098 fits; atac_small, immune, sim1; seeds 100-102; both decoders; lambda=0 + 6 arms x 10 lambda) on the local RTX 3080 with scripts/run_stage.py: 8 fit lanes, 3 scorers during fits, 12 after; start once the JHPCE gate's local scoring run has ended (by agent (lead), under SI-29/SI-30: local runs need no go; report to the user before the first fit)
- [NB-20261003-22](2026-10-03.md) X3 dose d: K0 = first N cells of one dose-independent permutation per task; remove the first round(d x h0_t) cells of each declared type t of K0 in permutation order; refill with the next non-declared cells in permutation order. SI-25 oracle weights: w[b, y] = n_K0(b, y) / n_Kd(b, y) per (batch, cell type) from the realised draws, doses 50/80/95, same arms, self-normalised. Every X3 spec carries draw 'nested_v1'; all 828 X3 tags change. (by agent (lead), implementing the user's SI-41 and SI-25 decisions; reported to the user)
- [NB-20261003-23](2026-10-03.md) (1) --tags-file restricts --experiments x --tasks to the listed tags (one per line, '#' comments; unknown tags, tags outside the selection, duplicates, empty lists and two tokens on a line are refused); the placeholder preflight sees the selected rows only; the ledger JSON records tags_file {path, sha256, n_tags} and the stage key gains __tags-<sha256[:12]> (own ledger and .done; the unfiltered key stays experiments__tasks). (2) Rows whose arm is in run_cpu_baselines.CPU_ARMS (harmony, scanorama, pca) are fitted by run_cpu_baselines.py --tag T --threads N on --cpu-lanes lanes (default 0: a selected CPU row that needs a fit is refused, also in --dry-run), validated by run_cpu_baselines.select_rows, and must record cfg device 'cpu' and a cpu_model (shared interface (b)); GPU rows keep --expect-device on cfg gpu; CPU rows need no model dir; a CPU exit 23 or status record is a broken contract (infrastructure, quarantined), never an outcome. (3) Score rows must carry scorer_git_sha, scorer_dirty, cpu_simd, numba_cpu_name and scorer_versions (else invalid: older scorer); the completion gate fails a stage whose scored rows disagree on any of them (mixed_scorer_provenance) and the preflight refuses such existing rows (not in --report-only). Exit codes, outcome classes and LEDGER_COLS unchanged. (by agent (implementation) per the lead's fix task (CR-02, CR-05) and the pinned interfaces (a)-(c), 2026-10-03)
- [NB-20261003-26](2026-10-03.md) A CPU-baseline fit that exits 0 with its non-finite latent saved is the outcome nonfinite_latent, whether the runner records it (no record present: as for GPU rows; detail names embedding values) or run_cpu_baselines.py recorded it with fit_outcome.write_status.
